content: All laboratories designated Level 2 (including Lab B-201 and B-202) must maintain an unobstructed 2.0-meter clearance corridor leading to the North Stairwell fire exit.
Sector B main electrical breaker unit (Panel HV-02) is situated in Utility Vault U-14 with automatic CO2 suppression system. Authorized technicians only.
Chemical fume extraction shafts vent vertically through the central service core C-3. Pressure differential sensors must trigger alarms if negative draft drops below 40 Pa.
